source: local mcp_tools.list_tool_descriptors() against the committed TOOLS registry

tools.description: Classify and summarize a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX file. Returns the inferred document type and a structured Markdown summary. Pass the file bytes directly as `content_base64` (max 10 MB decoded). The server does not fetch content from caller-supplied URLs.

filename.description: Name of the document with its extension (.pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx).

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes. Decoded size must not exceed 10 MB. The host must supply the attachment bytes directly; the server does not fetch content from external URLs.

tools.name: summarize_document
tools.title: Summarize a document

tools.description: Translate the text content of a DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX file into a target language. Returns the translated text as Markdown (no binary file round-trip). Pass the file bytes directly as `content_base64` (max 10 MB decoded). The server does not fetch content from caller-supplied URLs.

filename.description: Name of the document with its extension (.docx, .pptx, .xlsx).

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes. Decoded size must not exceed 10 MB. The host must supply the attachment bytes directly; the server does not fetch content from external URLs.

target_language.description: Target language for the translation (e.g. 'Spanish', 'French', 'Japanese', 'Korean'). Plain English name of the language.

tools.name: translate_document
tools.title: Translate a document

tools.description: Detect and redact personally identifiable information (PII) in a DOCX or PPTX file using Microsoft Presidio. Returns a short-lived HTTPS URL (`result_url`) where the redacted document can be downloaded. PII characters are replaced with the block symbol in place so formatting is preserved. Pass the file bytes directly as `content_base64` (max 10 MB decoded). The server does not fetch content from caller-supplied URLs.

filename.description: Name of the document with its extension (.docx or .pptx).

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes. Decoded size must not exceed 10 MB. The host must supply the attachment bytes directly; the server does not fetch content from external URLs.

tools.name: redact_pii
tools.title: Redact PII from a document

tools.description: Use Gemini vision to analyze an image and return a structured description, extracted text, safety flags (people / PII / graphic content), a list of detected objects, and a palette of the dominant colors. Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, HEIF up to 10 MB. Pass the image bytes directly as `content_base64`. The server does not fetch content from caller-supplied URLs.

filename.description: Name of the image with its extension (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .heic, .heif).

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes. Decoded size must not exceed 10 MB. The host must supply the attachment bytes directly; the server does not fetch content from external URLs.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.title: Analyze an image

annotations.title: Detect and obscure faces in an image

tools.description: Detect human faces in an image (MTCNN) and return a short-lived HTTPS URL (`result_url`) where the processed PNG can be downloaded — each face either blurred or covered with an opaque rectangle. Useful for anonymizing photos before sharing. Pass the image bytes directly as `content_base64` (JPG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC/HEIF, max 10 MB decoded). The server does not fetch content from caller-supplied URLs.

filename.description: Name of the image with its extension (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .heic, .heif).

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes. Decoded size must not exceed 10 MB. The host must supply the attachment bytes directly; the server does not fetch content from external URLs.

mode.description: How to obscure detected faces. 'blur' applies a Gaussian blur with padding; 'redact' draws a solid black rectangle. Defaults to 'blur'.

blur_strength.description: When mode='blur': 1=light, 2=strong (default), 3=opaque (equivalent to mode='redact'). Ignored when mode='redact'.

tools.name: detect_faces
tools.title: Detect and obscure faces in an image
